`enum GlContextRequest`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl3` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl3` · **Source:** [GlContextRequest.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl3/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl3/GlContextRequest.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The OpenGL context that a GLFW window asks for, set as window hints before the window exists.

## Description

Every request also asks for a 24-bit depth buffer and an 8-bit stencil buffer.

## Learn more

- [Start a backend](/use/learn/running/backends/#start-a-backend)
- [Context requests](/build/backends/lwjgl3/#context-requests)

<a id="GlContextRequest-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `void` | [apply](#GlContextRequest-method-apply)() | Sets the GLFW window hints of the request; call it after `glfwInit()` and before `glfwCreateWindow`. |
| `int` | [getMajor](#GlContextRequest-method-getMajor)() | Returns the major OpenGL version asked for, `0` for the default context of the driver. |
| `int` | [getMinor](#GlContextRequest-method-getMinor)() | Returns the minor OpenGL version asked for. |
| `boolean` | [isForwardCompatible](#GlContextRequest-method-isForwardCompatible)() | If `true`, the request asks for a forward-compatible context. |

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`COMPATIBILITY`](#GlContextRequest-value-COMPATIBILITY) | The default context of the driver, for an application that also draws with the fixed pipeline. |
| [`CORE_32_FORWARD_COMPATIBLE`](#GlContextRequest-value-CORE_32_FORWARD_COMPATIBLE) | An OpenGL 3.2 forward-compatible core profile, for a driver that offers no other core profile. |
| [`CORE_33`](#GlContextRequest-value-CORE_33) | An OpenGL 3.3 core profile, the usual request. |

## Method details

<a id="GlContextRequest-method-apply"></a>

### apply

`void apply()` 

Sets the GLFW window hints of the request; call it after `glfwInit()` and before `glfwCreateWindow`.
On macOS, a core profile is always forward-compatible.

<a id="GlContextRequest-method-getMajor"></a>

### getMajor

`int getMajor()` 

Returns the major OpenGL version asked for, `0` for the default context of the driver.

<a id="GlContextRequest-method-getMinor"></a>

### getMinor

`int getMinor()` 

Returns the minor OpenGL version asked for.

<a id="GlContextRequest-method-isForwardCompatible"></a>

### isForwardCompatible

`boolean isForwardCompatible()` 

If `true`, the request asks for a forward-compatible context.
